A whitespace-only subscript keeps the word separator

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>A<sub> </sub>B</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
